```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-iris
iris |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Measurements for Different Species of Iris",
    subtitle = "Virginica has the longest sepals",
    x = "Sepal Width",
    y = "Sepal Length",
    caption = "Fisher (1936)"
  )
```
